items.title: MUFG and Standard Chartered back buy now, pay later firm Tamara
items.why: Bank capital backing BNPL signals institutional comfort with pay-over-time, relevant to embedded installment strategy.
items.summary_ai: Two global banks, MUFG and Standard Chartered, have put backing behind Tamara, a buy now, pay later provider.
items.take: Bank capital backing BNPL signals institutional comfort with pay-over-time, relevant to embedded installment strategy.
